manualFollowUps: Content-only release: 13 public TOEFL Playbook modules (370 sections, about 62,000 words) and 24 official ETS sources, generated by scripts/content/toefl-pb-modules.mjs from content/toefl-playbook/. No frontend, Edge Function, worker or secret changes.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026170000_toefl_playbook_public_modules.sql, keeping the 9 pending #220 payment migrations and any other agent's unreleased migrations excluded. Dry run first. The migration only inserts into toefl_playbook_sources, toefl_playbook_pages, toefl_playbook_page_sections and toefl_playbook_page_sources with deterministic ids and on conflict do nothing; it aborts if the TOEFL Playbook product f9512c15-ec1c-4fcb-a5ec-a2c6ac3a020e is missing.

Order: independent of the playbooks-engine release. The live toefl-playbook function already serves /catalog and /pages/<slug> for published public modules, so pages appear as soon as the migration is applied.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026170000 applied and the #220 payment migrations still pending.
GET /functions/v1/toefl-playbook/catalog with the anon key returns 13 modules in sort order 1-13, starting with toefl-essentials and ending with retake-and-mybest-strategy.
GET /functions/v1/toefl-playbook/pages/score-scale-2026 returns 26 sections and its ETS sources; https://playbook.toefl.schood.online/score-scale-2026 renders the band, CEFR and 0-120 tables.

Locally verified before release: generator validation (3,000-6,000 words and 20+ sections per module), PGlite apply of the TOEFL Playbook schema plus this migration twice (idempotent; 13 pages, 370 sections, 24 sources, 74 links; ids match md5 contract), and a render pass of every section through react-markdown with the renderer's Markdown heuristic.

rollback.migration: Content only. To withdraw, set status = 'archived' on toefl_playbook_pages where metadata->>'seeded_by' = '20261026170000_toefl_playbook_public_modules' (sections and source links follow the page). Do not delete rows learners may have bookmarked or events reference.
